title: AI chat assistant entry point on the bill page
overview: AI chat assistant entry point on the bill page for Nimbus Wireless or Nimbus Prepaid customers on app or web. Headline ask: Add a "Questions about your bill?" entry point on the bill page that opens the AI chat assistant. This spec captures 5 functional and 4 non-functional requirements, 5 tracking events, the rollout and test plan, and the open questions the request leaves unanswered (section 15).
problem_statement: Billing questions are the largest driver of care calls in the first week after a bill is issued. Most of them are simple, such as why the bill went up or when a promo credit ends. The AI chat assistant already exists in the Help section, but very few customers find it from the bill page.
goals: Increase the share of bill-page chat sessions resolved without an agent
non_goals: Changing the assistant's underlying model or knowledge base
Proactive push notifications about the bill

functional_requirements.description: Add a "Questions about your bill?" entry point on the bill page that opens the AI chat assistant.
When opened from the bill page, the assistant must receive the current bill period and account context so the customer does not have to re-explain.
Customers must be able to escalate to a live care agent from the chat at any time.
Customers should be able to rate each answer with thumbs up or thumbs down.
Track entry point views, chat opens, messages, escalations and ratings.

non_functional_requirements.description: The assistant must never display full payment card or bank account numbers.
The entry point should be intuitive [measurable target for 'intuitive' TBD: OQ-3].
All new UI on app or web meets WCAG 2.1 AA (screen-reader labels, 4.5:1 contrast, full keyboard/switch access).
Tracking events contain zero PII: no names, phone numbers, free-text message content or full account/card numbers.
The assistant should respond quickly [measurable target for 'quickly' TBD: OQ-3].

analytics.naming_convention: snake_case <object>_<action>; action is a past-tense verb (viewed, selected, submitted…)

global_properties.name: platform
global_properties.description: Surface the event fired on (app or web)

global_properties.name: brand
global_properties.description: Brand the customer account belongs to

events.name: ai_chat_assistant_entry_viewed
events.description: The AI chat assistant entry point is displayed to the customer
events.trigger: Fires once per page load when the AI chat assistant entry point is at least 50% in the viewport

properties.name: entry_point
properties.description: Screen or link the customer came from

events.name: ai_chat_assistant_opened
events.description: Customer opened the AI chat assistant
events.trigger: Customer taps the AI chat assistant entry control and the AI chat assistant renders

properties.name: entry_point
properties.description: Screen or link the customer came from

events.name: ai_chat_assistant_message_sent
events.description: Customer sent a message in the AI chat assistant
events.trigger: Message is submitted from the AI chat assistant input (fires on client send)

properties.name: message_count
properties.description: Count of customer messages in the session so far

properties.name: message_length
properties.description: Characters in the message (content is never sent)

events.name: ai_chat_assistant_escalated
events.description: Conversation escalated to a live agent
events.trigger: Customer confirms the escalate-to-agent action and the handoff request is accepted

properties.name: escalation_reason
properties.description: Reason selected by the customer, if any

events.name: ai_chat_assistant_feedback_submitted
events.trigger: Customer taps thumbs up or thumbs down on an answer

success_metrics.name: Reduce billing-related calls to care
success_metrics.definition: Care contacts on this topic per 1,000 customers who fired `ai_chat_assistant_entry_viewed` (care data source TBD, OQ-5).

success_metrics.name: Increase the share of bill-page chat sessions resolved without an agent

data_model_changes.description: Register the new tracking events; update the modified ones: none.

edge_cases.scenario: Customer types a full card or bank number into the chat
edge_cases.expected_behavior: The number is masked in the transcript and never sent to analytics.

edge_cases.scenario: Customer in a group whose eligibility is unresolved (OQ-2: Should account sub-users (non-owners) see the entry point?)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Behaviour follows the answer to OQ-2; until it is resolved the feature stays hidden for that group.

edge_cases.scenario: Customer starts on app and finishes on web (or vice versa)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Same content on both; events keep identical names and differ only in `platform`.

edge_cases.scenario: Analytics is blocked or consent is declined
edge_cases.expected_behavior: The feature works normally; no events are sent and no errors are shown.

risks.description: Event names drift between app and web, breaking the cross-platform funnel
risks.mitigation: Treat section 7 as the single source; lint against the event dictionary in CI.

risks.description: Legal review changes what data can be used
risks.mitigation: Start review now; design for the minimal data set.

risks.description: 2 blocking open question(s) delay build start
risks.mitigation: Review open questions with owners before sprint planning.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility follows the company default of WCAG 2.1 AA.
Analytics events must not carry PII; this is standard instrumentation policy.
Rollout stages follow the standard flag-based ramp.

open_questions.question: What will Legal approve regarding how bill data is shared with the assistant?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Build cannot be finalised until the review outcome is known.

open_questions.question: Should account sub-users (non-owners) see the entry point?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The request explicitly leaves this open; it changes scope or eligibility logic.

open_questions.question: What measurable target defines 'intuitive', 'quickly' in: "The entry point should be intuitive and the assistant should respond quickly"?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a threshold the requirement cannot be tested or accepted.

open_questions.question: What is the target and timeframe for: "Reduce billing-related calls to care"?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Success metrics need a target to size the rollout and judge the launch.

open_questions.question: Which care-contact data source and reason codes identify the calls in: "Reduce billing-related calls to care"?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The metric cannot be computed from app/web events alone.

open_questions.question: What is the target and timeframe for: "Increase the share of bill-page chat sessions resolved without an agent"?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Success metrics need a target to size the rollout and judge the launch.

open_questions.question: Is `ai_chat_assistant_opened` the same user action as existing `chat_assistant_opened`? If so, reuse the existing event.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Avoids two events for one action, which double-counts the funnel.

open_questions.question: Is `ai_chat_assistant_message_sent` the same user action as existing `chat_assistant_message_sent`? If so, reuse the existing event.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Avoids two events for one action, which double-counts the funnel.
